research_question: 输入编码如何影响训练对变换配对选择性的重塑？
phase_authorized_now: implementation, verification, protocol and cost planning only; formal training not launched

canonical_cycle_grammar.rule: Follow pi, rotate each cycle to start at its minimum, sort cycles by their minima, retain all singleton cycles.

data.split_rule: Sequential unbiased acceptance of seeded random permutations, reject non-eight-element orbits/history/within-world overlap; no answer-based balancing or selection.
data.independence: Independent data/model/batch/dropout seeds per unit, conditional on the fixed mathematical universe and historical exclusions. Do not force global cross-world disjointness; accidental overlaps do not enter cross-world model comparisons.

training.precision: FP32 parameters, CUDA BF16 autocast, TF32 disabled; FP32 CPU fallback
training.loss: Answer token plus EOS, shifted causal CE, other targets ignored; same two supervised tokens/example in both encodings.
training.length_schedule: Uniform random permutations of all 21 lengths, repeat then truncate to20k; final length counts differ by at most1.
training.batch_schedule: 64 distinct anchors sampled per update from that length; saved batch_indices.npy shared by all32 models of a unit.
training.endpoint: Fixed final20k update checkpoint; no best-checkpoint or early-stopping selection.
training.execution: Single GPU, serial jobs; no concurrent step0 creation. Resume only when protocol/data/start hashes agree.

initialization.original_step0: One real post-constructor-and-weight-tying CPU snapshot/unit, before optimizer or training forwards; all32 models load its exact parameters.
initialization.task_start_rng: One real task-specific pre-forward RNG snapshot shared by its paired encodings; parameters trace to unit step0; independent task-dropout seeds fixed above.
initialization.limitation: Same exact weights do not imply equal initialization geometry across encodings; do not promise bitwise trained trajectories across CUDA/software versions.

historical_exclusions.scope: All original 16m parent inputs plus all currently identified local input-bearing archives; all eight members of every new selected orbit must avoid the fixed history index.

evaluation.landmark: final_norm at actual encoded-input end token, strictly before task; task query readout used only for output/accuracy controls.
evaluation.feature_dtype: FP32 evaluation, no autocast, TF32 disabled; float64 CKA kernels.
evaluation.length_weights: Fixed1/21, complete all21 or mark unit endpoint missing; never renormalize by dropping undefined lengths.
evaluation.strata: (n,left answer on identity,right answers on identity/complement/inverse), retain count>=3; subtract within-stratum mean separately; identical anchors across encodings/conditions.
evaluation.primary_contrast: Gamma_Delta = Delta(canonical_cycle) - Delta(one_line), paired within unit; two-sided mean test.
required_controls: All8 relations and raw within-length ordinary CKA
true-answer scalar/one-hot geometry, zero variance remains undefined
model numeric probability geometry and its full paired decomposition
full-vocabulary task accuracy and numeric-conditional accuracy per length/action
evaluation.no_extra_analysis: No kernel/length/metric/task search, no output-minus-hidden mechanism calculation, no new geometry loss or combination/LIS intervention; no task-count/larger-model extension.
evaluation.source_failures: Report weak task learning rather than drop it. Missing checkpoints: do not issue a complete primary result. Undefined unit endpoints: report missing and no full planned-sample test; do not add units or replace data.
evaluation.interpretability: Delta sign does not diagnose learning; Gamma_Delta sign or significance does not imply BT flips. B0 and BT are co-reported; components are algebraic not causal percentages.

statistics.independent_unit: One jointly resampled source initialization/data-world/batch stream; fixed task domain and relations are not independent universes.
statistics.test: Paired unit effects, two-sided Student t; Bonferroni alpha=.025 each.
statistics.primary_interval: Simultaneous95% across the two primary Gamma_Delta relations, t quantile .9875.
statistics.auxiliary_intervals: Pointwise95% descriptive for Gamma_initial/Gamma_trained/correct/wrong components. No joint10-contrast guarantee or equivalence claim.
statistics.variance_status: Prospective planning scenario, not an empirically established upper bound; not estimated from an unobserved encoding contrast or borrowed F17 variance.
statistics.design_policy: FixedN selected before any new neural outcome; no adaptive source expansion or stopping based on signs/significance. Actual precision may miss target.
statistics.assumption: Unit-effect t inference requires adequate distributional behavior; report estimates/distribution, not a distribution-free guarantee.

completion_rule: For this requested stage stop after code, tests, frozen protocol, manifests and cost report. Do not invoke prepare/train/evaluate on formal units.
